newTables.purpose: Named business or branch policy definition

constraints.name: booking_policy_business_id_branch_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (business_id, branch_id) REFERENCES ms_b1_design.branch(business_id, id)

newTables.name: booking_policy_version
newTables.purpose: Versioned structured deposit/cancellation/refund terms; frozen after publication

constraints.name: booking_policy_version_business_id_policy_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (business_id, policy_id) REFERENCES ms_b1_design.booking_policy(business_id, id)

constraints.name: booking_policy_version_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (((effective_to IS NULL) OR (isfinite(effective_to) AND (effective_to > effective_from))))

constraints.name: booking_policy_version_check1
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((deposit_requirement = 'NONE'::text) AND (num_nonnulls(amount_kind, fixed_rial, basis_points, minimum_rial, maximum_rial) = 0)) OR ((deposit_requirement <> 'NONE'::text) AND (amount_kind IS NOT NULL) AND (((amount_kind = 'FIXED'::text) AND (fixed_rial IS NOT NULL) AND (fixed_rial > 0) AND ((fixed_rial % (10)::bigint) = 0) AND (basis_points IS NULL)) OR ((amount_kind = 'PERCENTAGE'::text) AND (basis_points IS NOT NULL) AND ((basis_points >= 1) AND (basis_points <= 10000)) AND (fixed_rial IS NULL))))))

constraints.name: booking_policy_version_check2
constraints.definition: CHECK (((minimum_rial IS NULL) OR (maximum_rial IS NULL) OR (minimum_rial <= maximum_rial)))

constraints.name: booking_policy_version_check3
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((lifecycle = 'DRAFT'::text) AND (published_at IS NULL) AND (content_hash IS NULL)) OR ((lifecycle <> 'DRAFT'::text) AND (published_at IS NOT NULL) AND (content_hash IS NOT NULL) AND (octet_length(content_hash) = 32))))

newTables.name: policy_refund_window
newTables.purpose: Relational inclusive refund thresholds of an immutable version

newTables.name: booking_policy_assignment
newTables.purpose: Temporal scoped routing and reviewed revocation; native overlap exclusion

constraints.name: booking_policy_assignment_business_id_branch_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (business_id, branch_id) REFERENCES ms_b1_design.branch(business_id, id)

constraints.name: booking_policy_assignment_business_id_context_key_priority_excl
constraints.definition: EXCLUDE USING gist (business_id WITH =, context_key WITH =, priority WITH =, applicable_period WITH &&) WHERE ((revoked_at IS NULL))

constraints.name: booking_policy_assignment_business_id_service_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (business_id, service_id) REFERENCES ms_b1_design.service(business_id, id)

constraints.name: booking_policy_assignment_business_id_staff_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (business_id, staff_id) REFERENCES ms_b1_design.staff(business_id, id)

constraints.name: booking_policy_assignment_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (((effective_to IS NULL) OR (isfinite(effective_to) AND (effective_to > effective_from))))

constraints.name: booking_policy_assignment_check1
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((scope_kind = 'BUSINESS'::text) AND (num_nonnulls(branch_id, service_id, staff_id) = 0)) OR ((scope_kind = 'BRANCH'::text) AND (branch_id IS NOT NULL) AND (service_id IS NULL) AND (staff_id IS NULL)) OR ((scope_kind = 'SERVICE'::text) AND (service_id IS NOT NULL) AND (staff_id IS NULL)) OR ((scope_kind = 'STAFF'::text) AND (branch_id IS NOT NULL) AND (staff_id IS NOT NULL) AND (service_id IS NULL)) OR ((scope_kind = 'STAFF_SERVICE'::text) AND (branch_id IS NOT NULL) AND (staff_id IS NOT NULL) AND (service_id IS NOT NULL)) OR ((scope_kind = 'WHOLE_BOOKING'::text) AND (branch_id IS NOT NULL) AND (service_id IS NULL) AND (staff_id IS NULL) AND (override_reason IS NOT NULL) AND ((length(btrim(override_reason)) >= 1) AND (length(btrim(override_reason)) <= 200)))))
